user.title: Area Selection
user.description: Select the Home Assistant area to configure.

actuators.title: Actuators
actuators.description: Configure light and relay entities. At least one is required.

data.occupancy_timeout: Occupancy timeout — seconds after last motion before dimming warning starts
data.failsafe_timeout: Failsafe timeout — seconds without any motion before forced OFF (resets on every motion)
data.adaptive_window: Adaptive window — time window (s) for counting activations to detect high-traffic situations
data.adaptive_threshold: Adaptive threshold — number of activations in window before extending occupancy timeout
data.adaptive_multiplier: Adaptive multiplier — factor applied per activation over threshold (e.g. 1.5 = 50% longer each time)
data.adaptive_max_factor: Adaptive max factor — maximum timeout extension (e.g. 4.0 = timeout can be at most 4× longer)
data.perm_override_timeout: Permanent override timeout — auto-exit after N seconds (0 = never expires)
data.lux_hysteresis_pct: Lux hysteresis % — how much above threshold lux must rise to trigger natural-light auto-off (e.g. 10 = 10% above threshold)
data.lux_hysteresis_time: Lux hysteresis time — seconds lux must stay above threshold before auto-off triggers
data.temp_override_timeout: Temp override timeout — return to auto after N seconds of inactivity (0 = never, stays until next click)
data.warning_dim_pct: Warning dim % — brightness during pre-off dim (e.g. 30 = dim to 30%)
data.warning_dim_duration: Warning dim duration — seconds to stay dimmed before turning off (0 = turn off immediately)
data.no_motion_timeout: No-motion fallback — if occupancy sensor stays ON but no motion detected for N seconds, trigger dim and turn off. Protects against stuck sensors (0 = disabled)

profiles.title: Brightness Profiles
profiles.description: Configure normal and soft brightness profiles.
